_comment: WhatsApp Bot (whatsapp-web.js / Puppeteer) — universal egg for ANY whatsapp-web.js based WhatsApp bot. Auto-installs Chromium dependencies.
name: WhatsApp Bot (whatsapp-web.js)
author: Caltex254
description: Universal egg for ANY WhatsApp bot built on whatsapp-web.js (Puppeteer-based). Auto-installs Chromium dependencies on the Yolks image. Auto-detects the entry file. Supports persistent sessions via .wwebjs_auth folder. Compatible with popular whatsapp-web.js bot frameworks. NOTE: For best Puppeteer compatibility, use the Debian-based Yolks image (ghcr.io/pterodactyl/yolks:node_20).

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f whatsapp-webjs-start.sh ]; then
    cat > whatsapp-webjs-start.sh <<'STARTSH'
#!/bin/sh
echo '[install] Placeholder.'
STARTSH
fi
chmod +x whatsapp-webjs-start.sh
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.wwebjs_auth
echo '[install] WhatsApp Bot (whatsapp-web.js) egg ready.'

variables.name: Bot Owner Phone (optional)
variables.description: Phone number of the bot owner (used by some bots for owner-only commands). International format, no + or spaces.

variables.name: Command Prefix
variables.description: Prefix for bot commands. Use '.' for .menu, .ping etc.

variables.name: Puppeteer Executable Path (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Override Puppeteer's Chromium path. Auto-detected by default. Leave blank unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: Max Restart Retries
variables.description: Number of times to auto-restart on crash before giving up.
